slides.text: at eight, i hated getting your navy jumper with your name written on the tag. today, i'd give anything to [[wear something you outgrew]].

caption:
having someone four years ahead meant the map was already drawn before you got there.
send this to the older sibling who had to test every curfew first.

#siblings #oldersiblings #siblinglove #growingupwithsiblings
